description: Cancel-records rows that matched a picking order but applied nothing (order already cancelled/shipped, TN line not found) stored no `picking_order_id`, so the list could not link to the order detail — the 揀貨單 column showed "—" and the invoice/TN cell was dead text
reproSteps: Cancel an order twice (or cancel a shipped one) → open Admin → Picking → Cancel invoices → the row's 發票 / TN and 揀貨單 cells have no link even though the order exists
remarks: Fixed in commit b447a25b (`applyCancel` records the matched order for every outcome) + f5a27818 (invoice/TN cell links to `/picking-orders/:id`); existing dev-DB rows backfilled by order_no where the match was unambiguous
